methodology: Blind same-model re-code via context-isolated subagent instances (fresh Agent calls with zero access to this conversation or to results/tokens_*.json), not a time-based 24h gap. See plan sec 4.6 for rationale: a time gap does not blind an LLM within the same context, since nothing decays; a fresh, isolated agent instance given only the rubric and raw source files provides genuine blindness to the original verdict. Caveat: this tests memory-independent consistency, not independence from systematic model bias -- two instances of the same underlying model may share correlated judgment tendencies that two different human coders would not. Framed here as what it is, not oversold as inter-rater reliability.
